title: Exporting servis mobil: what comes with the file
description: Exporting servis mobil: what to expect in the exported file, the weekly check to keep it current, and on-device storage when you switch to a new phone.
answer: On Friday your servis mobil notes are a dozen half-finished lines with no comparable dates. GarageGo keeps servis mobil on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

sections.p: Once a week, look at the part that breaks most often and shrink the target instead of adding willpower.
GarageGo keeps servis mobil on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.
If you miss several days, do not wipe history. Open the last entry, fill in one day, then close.

list: Pick one fixed time, not “whenever there is room”.
Open GarageGo when that time arrives, not later tonight.

faqs: Can I open servis mobil offline?
Yes. GarageGo keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.
Do I need an account first?
No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.
With the shortest piece. Add scope only after two steady weeks.
What if I miss a few days?
Do not wipe history. Resume from the last entry and note one blocker.
